rationale: The base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5, which only supports protocol v3, while the den camera (CAM-I2, fw 1.2) still speaks protocol v2, producing E-305. The camera's hardware revision A has no OTA path to v3 (confirmed by check_firmware_compat and KB manual), so it cannot be fixed by a frontline firmware update and requires FAE escalation for a compatibility firmware.

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

results.source: historical_cases#H-03 Indoor camera lost after night update
results.text: After HB-200 auto-updated to 4.5, a CAM-I2 running 1.2 disconnected with E-305. OTA not offered for this hardware revision. Escalated; FAE confirmed protocol v2 dropped and arranged a compatibility firmware. Escalated correctly.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.

complaint: The den camera remains offline after the base station updated last night. I cannot find a firmware update for it in the app. Support told me last time to just update the camera, but there is no button. My neighbour has the same camera model and hers still works, so I suspect my unit is broken.
usability_reason: The response is clear, polite, and actionable: it explains the compatibility issue, sets an expectation (engineer contact within 2 business days), and tells the customer no action is needed. It avoids claiming any checks or fixes were completed beyond what the record supports. Minor deduction because it does not explicitly address the customer's concern that the unit may be broken, and the root-cause explanation is somewhat technical for a support reply.
